text.p: Following are the main stories in Wednesday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- Electricity users on Penang island will receive an additional 10 percent rebate as goodwill payment from Tenaga Nasional Bhd for a 10-day power disruption in June last year, said Energy, Telecommunications and Posts Minister Leo Moggie.

-- Economic Advisor to the Government Daim Zainuddin said there was nothing wrong with state investment fund Khazanah Nasional Bhd's intention to part-finance a proposed mega deal, since aborted, by YTL Corp Bhd.
-- Proton has acquired a controlling stake in British sports car maker Lotus Group.
-- Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd has obtained approval from Bank Negara to start negotiations for a stake in Rashid Hussain Bhd.

-- Energy, Telecommunications and Posts Minister Leo Moggie said a meeting between his ministry, power company Tenaga Nasional and the independent power producer firms (IPPs) will take place soon. The meeting is to discuss the involvement of the IPPs in rural electrification.
